title: The why and the how
src: Nietzsche, Twilight of the Idols, Maxims and Arrows 12
idea: If you have a why for your life, you can put up with almost any how. A clear purpose makes hardship bearable.
apply: Write one sentence on why a hard task matters to you, and read it before you start.
remind: Know your why. The how gets easier.
who: Omar, who works nights and studies in the evenings.

scenes.nar: Omar works nights at a warehouse and takes evening classes. He sleeps four hours a day, and he is close to quitting.

msgs.x: Why am I doing this to myself?
Every shift feels longer than the last.

scenes.nar: Each shift feels longer than the last. He keeps asking how he can survive the schedule, and without a reason behind it, the how feels impossible.

items: A better life for his daughter

scenes.nar: Nietzsche wrote that with a why, you can bear almost any how. Omar writes his why on a card: a nursing degree and a better life for his daughter.
He reads the card before every shift. The schedule does not change, but it feels lighter, and he passes every exam.
